desc: Branch skeleton restructure in TreeGen.cpp (brainstorm task 1): add per-level startFrac + relative child-radius multiplier (radius[level] x parent local radius at attach) to LevelCfg/grow; spawn one tip 'continuation' child per branch (same dir, tip radius) in addition to side children; lift nsec>6 / sides>8 caps so the trunk gets ~11 sections / ~10 sides; rewrite configDeciduous() to reference ratios: 4 levels (trunk len 0.50, r 0.05, taper 0.7, 7 side children, start 0.23, angle 48 deg; L1 len ~0.30, mult 0.63, 4+cont, start 0.33, angle 75 deg, 6 sec/4 sides; L2 len ~0.12, mult 0.76, 3+cont, angle 60 deg, 4 sec/3 sides; twig len ~0.055, mult 0.70, angle 60 deg, 3 sec/3 sides), twist ~0.09/-0.07 on first two levels, gnarliness ~0.03-0.25 per level. Keep tiny BLOBS (r ~0.05-0.08) at twig tips as stand-ins; keep DECIDUOUS_FAR cheap. Verify via ENGINE_AZGAAR_PROPS_MESH_DUMP: thin smooth tall trunk, 7 low forks at 0.23H, ~48 twig tips filling ~0.35H crown, branch tris <= ~1300, validateMesh PASS.
result: Deciduous skeleton now matches reference ratios: 4-level config with relRadius/startFrac/twist/gnarliness per level, continuation tips, 11-sec/10-side smooth trunk, fixed 7/1/2/0 side counts -> exactly 48 twig tips per variant; branch tris ~1040, total ~2720/variant, validateMesh PASS; deviations (child counts, startFrac units, gnarliness scaling, angleJitter 0.1, lift 0.6) recorded in notes.md round 1.
